title: explorer-verify --version --json
description: The envelope that `explorer-verify --version --json` prints on stdout, with exit code 0 (R-AX-11). Within schemaVersion 1, a release may add fields, so readers ignore fields they do not know. Keys appear in the order the properties below list them.

core.description: The version of the explorer-verify core package the CLI runs.

routingTableDate.description: The date of the routing table the core ships: the newest check of any row.
